entries.name: Current transformer

entries.name: Voltage transformer

entries.name: Normally closed pushbutton

entries.name: Resistor

entries.name: Protective earth

entries.name: Battery

entries.name: Synchronism check

entries.name: Directional power

entries.name: Thermal protection

entries.name: Instantaneous overcurrent

entries.name: Time overcurrent

entries.name: AC circuit breaker

entries.name: Overvoltage
entries.summary: A function responding to voltage above its configured operating criteria.

entries.name: Directional overcurrent
entries.summary: An overcurrent function with a documented direction criterion.

entries.name: AC autoreclosing
entries.summary: A function coordinating a documented automatic reclosing sequence.

entries.name: Frequency protection

entries.name: Lockout

entries.name: Differential protection

entries.name: Line switch

entries.name: Switchgear panel

entries.name: Ring main unit

entries.name: Transformer envelope

entries.name: Battery storage cabinet
entries.summary: A generic storage-equipment envelope linked to the selected battery system.

entries.name: Power conversion cabinet
entries.summary: A generic envelope for the selected power-conversion equipment and its interfaces.

entries.name: Generator package
entries.summary: A generic generating-package envelope linked to official equipment and installation drawings.

entries.name: Transfer-switch assembly
entries.summary: An equipment assembly connecting a load to the selected supply source.

entries.name: Control / marshalling cabinet
entries.summary: A generic cabinet organising control equipment, terminals and field interfaces.

entries.name: Cable ladder / tray
entries.summary: A generic route object connecting cable-support layout to the selected system.

entries.name: Busbar trunking
entries.summary: A physical enclosed distribution system with model-specific sections and fittings.

entries.name: Mounting plate
entries.summary: An enclosure mounting surface supporting the selected internal components.

entries.name: Terminal strip assembly
entries.summary: A physical assembly of identified terminals and the selected connecting accessories.

entries.name: Master element
entries.summary: Starts or enables the principal operating sequence of a machine or power-system unit.

entries.name: Time-delay starting or closing relay
entries.summary: Introduces a deliberate interval before a starting or closing operation is permitted.

entries.name: Checking or interlocking relay
entries.summary: Checks a required equipment state before the operating sequence proceeds.

entries.name: Master contactor
entries.summary: Switches the main control or operating circuit under the unit's master command.

entries.name: Stopping device
entries.summary: Initiates a machine or unit shutdown by removing the relevant operating permission.

entries.name: Starting circuit breaker
entries.summary: Connects a machine to the electrical supply used during starting.

entries.name: Rate-of-change relay
entries.summary: Responds to how quickly a monitored quantity changes rather than only its absolute magnitude.

entries.name: Control power disconnecting device
entries.summary: Isolates the supply feeding a control circuit or control-power bus.

entries.name: Reversing device
entries.summary: Changes the operating connection to reverse the direction of a machine or power circuit.

entries.name: Unit sequence switch
entries.summary: Selects or determines the order in which multiple units enter an operating sequence.

entries.name: Multifunction device
entries.summary: Identifies a device that performs several separately described protection or control functions.

entries.name: Overspeed device
entries.summary: Responds when machine speed exceeds the documented operating criterion.

entries.name: Synchronous-speed device
entries.summary: Recognises a speed condition associated with synchronism during a machine sequence.

entries.name: Underspeed device
entries.summary: Responds to machine speed below the required operating level.

entries.name: Speed or frequency matching device
entries.summary: Adjusts or supervises the difference between two speed or frequency references.

entries.name: Data communications device
entries.summary: Identifies equipment carrying data between control, protection or monitoring devices.

entries.name: Shunting or discharge switch
entries.summary: Changes a circuit connection to bypass a component or provide a discharge path.

entries.name: Accelerating or decelerating device
entries.summary: Controls a machine action that changes its operating speed during a sequence.

entries.name: Starting-to-running transition contactor
entries.summary: Changes the machine connection from its starting arrangement to its running arrangement.

entries.name: Electrically operated valve
entries.summary: Commands a valve through an electrical actuator or solenoid.

entries.name: Distance protection
entries.summary: Uses measured voltage and current to assess an electrical distance or impedance characteristic.

entries.name: Equalizer circuit breaker
entries.summary: Switches an equalising connection used in a machine or generator arrangement.

entries.name: Temperature control device
entries.summary: Controls heating, cooling or another process action using a temperature input.

entries.name: Overexcitation protection
entries.summary: Supervises the voltage-to-frequency relationship associated with magnetic overexcitation.

entries.name: Apparatus thermal device
entries.summary: Responds to the temperature of equipment or a monitored part of that equipment.

entries.name: Flame detector
entries.summary: Provides electrical indication that combustion flame is present or absent.

entries.name: Isolating contactor
entries.summary: Provides a contactor-operated disconnection within a machine or power circuit.

entries.name: Annunciator relay
entries.summary: Operates an indication system that presents a detected condition to the operator.

entries.name: Separate excitation device
entries.summary: Connects or controls a separately supplied excitation arrangement for a machine.

entries.name: Position switch
entries.summary: Changes an electrical indication when a mechanism reaches a defined physical position.

entries.name: Master sequence device
entries.summary: Coordinates the steps of a machine or switching sequence.

entries.name: Brush-operating or slip-ring short-circuiting device
entries.summary: Changes the brush or slip-ring arrangement as part of a wound-rotor machine sequence.

entries.name: Polarity device
entries.summary: Supervises or establishes a required electrical polarity condition.

entries.name: Undercurrent or underpower protection
entries.summary: Recognises a current or power level below the documented minimum operating criterion.

entries.name: Bearing protective device
entries.summary: Supervises an abnormal condition at a machine bearing, often using temperature or mechanical sensing.

entries.name: Mechanical condition monitor
entries.summary: Converts a monitored mechanical condition into an electrical alarm or protection signal.

entries.name: Field or loss-of-excitation protection
entries.summary: Detects an abnormal machine excitation condition using the implementation's field or electrical measurements.

entries.name: Field circuit breaker
entries.summary: Applies or removes the electrical connection to a machine field circuit.

entries.name: Running circuit breaker
entries.summary: Connects a machine to the supply or connection used for normal running.

entries.name: Manual transfer or selector device
entries.summary: Selects an operating circuit, control source or mode through a manual action.

entries.name: Unit sequence starting relay
entries.summary: Starts the next unit or operating step when the documented sequence condition is met.

entries.name: Atmospheric condition monitor
entries.summary: Reports an ambient atmospheric condition relevant to equipment operation.

entries.name: Phase-sequence or voltage-balance protection
entries.summary: Supervises phase order or voltage imbalance using the selected device's voltage inputs.

entries.name: Incomplete-sequence relay
entries.summary: Detects that an operating or starting sequence has not completed as required.

entries.name: Exciter or DC generator relay
entries.summary: Supervises an exciter or DC generator condition in a machine control arrangement.

entries.name: Turning-gear engaging device
entries.summary: Controls engagement of the turning gear used to rotate a large machine at low speed.

entries.name: Power factor protection
entries.summary: Supervises power factor according to the selected relay's electrical measurement method.

entries.name: Field application relay
entries.summary: Initiates application of excitation at the appropriate step of a machine starting sequence.

entries.name: Short-circuiting or grounding device
entries.summary: Makes a defined short-circuit or earth connection for the purpose shown in the machine or apparatus scheme.

entries.name: Rectification failure relay
entries.summary: Detects failure or abnormal operation in a rectifier arrangement.

entries.name: Voltage or current balance relay
entries.summary: Compares related measured circuits or quantities to detect an abnormal imbalance.

entries.name: Density switch or sensor
entries.summary: Monitors the density of a medium used by electrical equipment.

entries.name: Time-delay stopping or opening relay
entries.summary: Introduces a documented delay in a stopping or opening operation.

entries.name: Pressure switch or relay
entries.summary: Provides an electrical response to a gas, liquid or other pressure condition.

entries.name: Ground detector protection
entries.summary: Identifies an earth or ground fault using the circuit arrangement specified for the device.

entries.name: Governor
entries.summary: Regulates the operating speed or mechanical input of a generating or rotating unit.

entries.name: Notching or jogging device
entries.summary: Controls limited machine movements or, in modern motor relays, supervises the allowed starting duty.

entries.name: Blocking or out-of-step supervision
entries.summary: Restrains or coordinates another protection action under the specified system condition.

entries.name: Permissive control device
entries.summary: Permits or prevents an equipment operation according to a selected control condition.

entries.name: Rheostat
entries.summary: Provides adjustable resistance in a control, excitation or machine circuit.

entries.name: Level switch or relay
entries.summary: Signals a defined level condition in the monitored equipment.

entries.name: DC circuit breaker
entries.summary: Interrupts or switches a direct-current power circuit using a breaker selected for DC duty.

entries.name: Load-resistor contactor
entries.summary: Switches a resistor used to impose, remove or change electrical load in a machine arrangement.

entries.name: Alarm relay
entries.summary: Provides an electrical alarm output for a documented monitored condition.

entries.name: Position-changing mechanism
entries.summary: Moves an apparatus between defined physical positions.

entries.name: DC overcurrent relay
entries.summary: Supervises excessive current in a direct-current circuit.

entries.name: Telemetering device
entries.summary: Transmits a measured quantity from its local measurement point to a remote indication or monitoring system.

entries.name: Phase-angle or out-of-step protection
entries.summary: Supervises the angular relationship or loss of synchronism of an electrical system or machine.

entries.name: Flow switch or relay
entries.summary: Reports a flow condition in a monitored gas or liquid circuit.

entries.name: DC load-measuring reclosing relay
entries.summary: Supervises a DC load condition as part of a documented reclosing arrangement.

entries.name: Automatic selective control or transfer relay
entries.summary: Automatically selects between control circuits or operating sources under defined conditions.

entries.name: Operating mechanism
entries.summary: Provides the motive action that operates electrical apparatus.

entries.name: Pilot or carrier receiver relay
entries.summary: Receives a communication-assisted protection signal used in a pilot or carrier scheme.

entries.name: Auxiliary motor or motor-generator
entries.summary: Identifies a motor or motor-generator serving an auxiliary equipment function.

entries.name: Regulating device
entries.summary: Adjusts equipment to maintain the controlled electrical or operating quantity.

entries.name: Voltage directional relay
entries.summary: Uses a voltage relationship with a defined direction criterion in a specialist protection or control scheme.

entries.name: Voltage and power directional relay
entries.summary: Combines voltage and power directional criteria in the specified control or protection arrangement.

entries.name: Field-changing contactor
entries.summary: Changes the machine excitation connection or arrangement as part of a controlled field sequence.

entries.name: Tripping or trip-free relay
entries.summary: Initiates a tripping action or provides the trip-related logic described in the scheme.

entries.name: Phase distance protection
entries.summary: Evaluates an impedance characteristic for phase-fault loops on the protected circuit.

entries.name: Ground distance protection
entries.summary: Evaluates a distance characteristic for a phase-to-earth fault loop.

entries.name: Admittance-based earth-fault protection
entries.summary: Uses earth-fault voltage and current relationships to assess an admittance-based directional criterion.

entries.name: Auxiliary-input undervoltage protection

entries.name: Main-input undervoltage protection

entries.name: Reactive-power undervoltage protection
entries.summary: Combines a reactive-power criterion with undervoltage supervision in the cited interconnection application.

entries.name: Low-voltage ride-through supervision
entries.summary: Supervises a voltage-time ride-through criterion used in a generator or interconnection application.

entries.name: Wattmetric earth-fault protection

entries.name: Directional reactive-power protection
entries.summary: Supervises forward or reverse reactive power using the selected relay's power-direction convention.

entries.name: Reverse-power protection
entries.summary: Detects active power flowing opposite to the defined generator or circuit direction.

entries.name: Underpower protection
entries.summary: Supervises active power below the documented operating criterion.

entries.name: Generator current-unbalance protection
entries.summary: Supervises generator current imbalance using the manufacturer's machine protection implementation.

entries.name: Phase-discontinuity protection

entries.name: RTD-based thermal protection
entries.summary: Uses resistance-temperature-detector measurements for an equipment thermal protection function.

entries.name: Motor thermal-model protection
entries.summary: Estimates motor thermal duty using the selected relay's motor thermal model.

entries.name: Instantaneous phase overcurrent
entries.summary: Supervises phase-current magnitude for the instantaneous overcurrent element.

entries.name: Instantaneous neutral overcurrent

entries.name: Instantaneous ground overcurrent

entries.name: Instantaneous negative-sequence overcurrent

entries.name: Measured ground instantaneous overcurrent
entries.summary: Supervises the instantaneous element using a separately measured ground or neutral input in the cited Eaton family.

entries.name: Circuit-breaker failure protection

entries.name: Motor jam or stall protection

entries.name: Time phase-overcurrent protection

entries.name: Time neutral-overcurrent protection
entries.summary: Supervises neutral or residual overcurrent with the configured timing characteristic.

entries.name: Time ground-overcurrent protection
entries.summary: Supervises ground-current overcurrent with the timing defined by the selected relay and scheme.

entries.name: Time negative-sequence overcurrent
entries.summary: Supervises negative-sequence current using a time-dependent operating criterion.

entries.name: Calculated residual time-overcurrent

entries.name: Measured ground time-overcurrent
entries.summary: Applies time-overcurrent protection to a separately measured ground or neutral input in the cited Eaton family.

entries.name: Voltage-dependent overcurrent

entries.name: Apparent power-factor supervision

entries.name: Displacement power-factor supervision

entries.name: Residual or neutral overvoltage

entries.name: Negative-sequence overvoltage
entries.summary: Supervises the negative-sequence component derived from three-phase voltage measurements.

entries.name: Auxiliary-input overvoltage

entries.name: Main-input overvoltage
entries.summary: Supervises high voltage using the main three-phase inputs in the cited Eaton family.

entries.name: Field ground-fault protection
entries.summary: Detects an earth fault in a machine field circuit using the selected field-ground detection arrangement.

entries.name: Stator ground-fault protection
entries.summary: Supervises generator stator earth faults using the selected stator-ground protection method.

entries.name: Directional phase-overcurrent
entries.summary: Combines phase-current overcurrent operation with the scheme's direction criterion.

entries.name: Directional neutral-overcurrent
entries.summary: Supervises neutral or residual overcurrent with a documented directional criterion.

entries.name: Directional ground-overcurrent
entries.summary: Supervises a ground-current quantity with direction determined by the selected relay's polarising method.

entries.name: Directional negative-sequence overcurrent
entries.summary: Uses negative-sequence quantities to supervise overcurrent operation in a defined direction.

entries.name: Calculated residual directional overcurrent
entries.summary: Applies directional overcurrent to calculated residual current in the cited Eaton application.

entries.name: Measured ground directional overcurrent
entries.summary: Applies directional supervision to the separately measured ground or neutral current element in the cited Eaton family.

entries.name: Multifrequency admittance earth-fault protection
entries.summary: Assesses earth-fault behaviour using the manufacturer's multifrequency admittance-based method.

entries.name: Transient or intermittent earth-fault protection
entries.summary: Supervises transient or intermittent earth-fault behaviour in the documented feeder application.

entries.name: Trip-coil monitoring

entries.name: Voltage vector-shift protection
entries.summary: Supervises an abrupt change in the measured voltage phase angle using the selected relay's vector-shift method.

entries.name: Underfrequency protection
entries.summary: Supervises frequency below the defined operating criterion.

entries.name: Overfrequency protection
entries.summary: Supervises frequency above the defined operating criterion.

entries.name: Rate-of-change-of-frequency protection
entries.summary: Supervises the rate at which measured electrical frequency changes.

entries.name: Transformer differential protection

entries.name: Busbar differential protection
entries.summary: Compares currents at the boundaries of a busbar protection zone.

entries.name: Generator differential protection
entries.summary: Compares current measurements bounding the selected generator differential zone.

entries.name: Motor differential protection
entries.summary: Compares current measurements defining a motor differential protection zone.

entries.name: Line current differential protection
entries.summary: Compares current information from the terminals of a protected line using a communication-assisted differential scheme.

entries.name: Neutral differential protection
entries.summary: Identifies a differential scheme involving neutral or residual-current quantities as defined by the equipment documentation.

entries.name: Negative-sequence differential protection
entries.summary: Compares negative-sequence current information across a differential protection zone.

entries.name: Restrained current differential protection
entries.summary: Uses a differential operating quantity with restraint in the cited transformer-relay application.

entries.name: Unrestrained high-set differential protection
entries.summary: Provides the documented high-set or unrestrained differential element in the cited relay family.

entries.name: Restricted ground differential protection
entries.summary: Compares ground-fault-related currents for the restricted zone defined by the cited relay application.

entries.name: Single-pole circuit breaker
entries.summary: A circuit breaker interrupts one pole of a circuit.

entries.summary: A thermal-magnetic breaker combines overload response with a magnetic response to high current.

entries.summary: A current-limiting breaker reduces the fault-current peak and energy passed to downstream equipment within its documented operating range.

entries.summary: A breaker undervoltage release changes the breaker operating condition when its control voltage falls below the specified range.

entries.name: Circuit breaker with electronic trip unit
entries.summary: A breaker electronic trip unit measures current and applies configured protection functions.

entries.name: Moulded-case circuit breaker

entries.name: Additional circuit-breaker pole

entries.name: Switch-disconnector

entries.name: Lockable disconnector

entries.summary: A lockable switch-disconnector combines an isolation-capable switching device with a documented locking provision.

entries.name: Three-position disconnector
entries.summary: A three-position disconnector selects between two paths and an intermediate position.

entries.name: Semiconductor power switch
entries.summary: A semiconductor power switch controls a power path electronically.

entries.name: Unidirectional semiconductor power switch
entries.summary: A unidirectional semiconductor switch has a specified direction for its power conduction or control behaviour.

entries.name: Two-pole power switch
entries.summary: A two-pole power switch operates two circuit conductors through a common device.

entries.summary: A normally-open disconnector auxiliary contact provides a separate indication or permissive circuit associated with the disconnector mechanism.

entries.name: Disconnector auxiliary NC contact
entries.summary: A normally-closed disconnector auxiliary contact is closed in the documented unactuated reference state.

entries.name: Fused switch

entries.name: Fuse-switch

entries.name: Additional fused-switch pole

entries.name: Motor full-range fuse
entries.summary: A gM fuse-link is a motor-circuit fuse with a characteristic chosen for starting and fault conditions.

entries.summary: This CT representation explicitly identifies the primary conductor passing through the measurement location.

entries.summary: A three-phase star-connected autotransformer has electrically shared winding portions arranged in a three-phase star connection.

entries.name: Star-star transformer

entries.name: Zigzag winding connection
entries.summary: A zigzag winding interconnects portions of phase windings in a specified arrangement.

entries.name: Polarised relay coil

entries.name: AC relay coil

entries.name: High-speed relay

entries.name: Measuring relay

entries.name: Schottky diode
entries.summary: A metal-semiconductor diode used for rectification or clamping with device-specific forward and reverse characteristics.

entries.name: Unidirectional TVS diode
entries.summary: A transient-suppression diode intended to clamp a documented surge polarity across a protected circuit.

entries.name: Light-emitting diode
entries.summary: A semiconductor diode that emits light when operated with the appropriate forward current.

entries.name: Varactor diode
entries.summary: A reverse-biased diode whose junction capacitance is used as a voltage-controlled circuit element.

entries.name: PIN diode
entries.summary: A diode structure used in applications such as RF switching or attenuation with a documented bias circuit.

entries.name: NPN bipolar transistor
entries.summary: A bipolar transistor with base, collector and emitter terminals arranged for NPN operation.

entries.name: PNP bipolar transistor
entries.summary: A bipolar transistor with base, collector and emitter terminals arranged for PNP operation.

entries.name: NPN Darlington transistor
entries.summary: Two NPN transistor stages connected as a Darlington pair to provide a combined current-amplifying device.

entries.name: PNP Darlington transistor
entries.summary: Two PNP transistor stages connected as a compound current-amplifying device.

entries.name: N-channel JFET
entries.summary: A junction field-effect transistor using an N-type channel controlled through a gate junction.

entries.name: P-channel JFET
entries.summary: A junction field-effect transistor using a P-type channel and the corresponding gate-bias polarity.

entries.name: N-channel enhancement MOSFET
entries.summary: An insulated-gate transistor whose N-channel conduction is enabled by the documented gate-to-source drive.

entries.name: P-channel enhancement MOSFET
entries.summary: An insulated-gate transistor using a P-channel and the corresponding gate-to-source drive polarity.

entries.name: N-channel depletion MOSFET
entries.summary: An N-channel insulated-gate device that conducts at zero gate-to-source voltage according to its device characteristics.

entries.name: Insulated-gate bipolar transistor
entries.summary: A power transistor combining insulated-gate control with a bipolar collector-emitter conduction structure.

entries.name: MOSFET body diode
entries.summary: The intrinsic diode associated with a MOSFET's semiconductor structure, often shown within the device reference.

entries.name: GaN enhancement-mode HEMT
entries.summary: A normally-off gallium-nitride high-electron-mobility transistor used as a controlled power switch.

entries.name: Integrated gate-commutated thyristor
entries.summary: A high-power thyristor device operated with an integrated gate-unit arrangement for controlled switching.

entries.name: NPN phototransistor
entries.summary: An NPN transistor whose collector-emitter conduction responds to incident light in the documented detector arrangement.

entries.name: Phototransistor optocoupler
entries.summary: An optical isolation component using an input light emitter and a transistor output on the isolated side.

entries.name: Photodiode optocoupler
entries.summary: An optically coupled component using photodiode output sensing for an isolation or feedback arrangement.

entries.name: Phototriac optocoupler
entries.summary: An optical isolation device whose output is a light-triggered triac-type switching element.

entries.name: Photovoltaic MOSFET driver
entries.summary: An optical component producing an isolated photovoltaic output used to drive a MOSFET gate circuit.

entries.name: Capacitive digital isolator
entries.summary: Transfers digital information between separately referenced electrical domains through a capacitive isolation structure.

entries.name: Isolated gate driver
entries.summary: Transfers a switching command across an isolation barrier and drives a power-transistor gate circuit.

entries.name: Low-side gate driver
entries.summary: Provides gate-drive current for a power switch referenced to the driver's low-side return.

entries.name: High-side gate driver
entries.summary: Drives a high-side power transistor with the output circuit referenced to its switching node.

entries.name: Bootstrap gate-drive supply
entries.summary: A diode-capacitor arrangement used to supply a floating high-side gate-driver circuit under documented switching conditions.

entries.name: Ideal-diode controller
entries.summary: Controls an external transistor to obtain the documented low-loss directional or reverse-blocking power path.

entries.name: Hot-swap controller
entries.summary: Controls a power path during equipment insertion or power-up to manage the documented inrush sequence.

entries.name: Electronic fuse IC
entries.summary: An integrated semiconductor power-path device providing the selected current-limiting and protection functions.

entries.name: Half-bridge power module
entries.summary: A packaged power-switch arrangement forming one half-bridge switching leg.

entries.name: Three-phase sixpack power module
entries.summary: A power module containing three switching legs for a three-phase bridge arrangement.

entries.name: AND gate
entries.summary: A logic element whose output is true when all stated positive-logic inputs are true.

entries.name: OR gate
entries.summary: A positive-logic element whose output is true when at least one input is true.

entries.name: NAND gate
entries.summary: A logic gate that inverts the result of an AND operation.

entries.name: NOR gate
entries.summary: A logic gate that inverts an inclusive-OR result.

entries.name: Exclusive-OR gate
entries.summary: For two positive-logic inputs, produces a true output when the input states differ.

entries.name: Exclusive-NOR gate
entries.summary: For two positive-logic inputs, produces a true output when the input states are equal.

entries.name: Logic inverter
entries.summary: Produces the opposite logical state of its defined digital input.

entries.name: Non-inverting logic buffer
entries.summary: Transfers a digital state through a non-inverting logic output stage.

entries.name: Three-state logic buffer
entries.summary: A digital output stage that can drive logical states or enter its documented high-impedance state.

entries.name: Schmitt-trigger inverter
entries.summary: A digital inverter with hysteresis between its input switching thresholds.

entries.name: Schmitt-trigger buffer
entries.summary: A non-inverting digital element with separate rising and falling input thresholds.

entries.name: Positive-edge D flip-flop
entries.summary: Captures its data input at the documented positive clock edge and retains that digital state.

entries.name: Negative-edge JK flip-flop
entries.summary: Updates or toggles its stored state from J and K inputs at the selected negative clock edge.

entries.name: Set-reset latch
entries.summary: Retains a digital state that is changed by the defined set or reset input conditions.

entries.name: Transparent D latch
entries.summary: Follows the input data while its latch-enable condition is active and retains it when that condition ends.

entries.name: Serial-in parallel-out register
entries.summary: Shifts serial input data through storage stages to parallel outputs at the documented clock events.

entries.name: Parallel-in serial-out register
entries.summary: Loads a parallel word and presents its bits through a serial shift output.

entries.name: Shift register with output latch
entries.summary: Combines a serial shift path with a separate output-storage stage.

entries.name: Ripple binary counter
entries.summary: Counts clock events through cascaded storage stages whose output changes do not occur simultaneously.

entries.name: Synchronous binary counter
entries.summary: Updates its binary count from a common clock with the documented count-enable, load and clear controls.

entries.name: Decoded decade counter
entries.summary: Advances a decoded output sequence through the documented ten-state counter arrangement.

entries.name: Retriggerable monostable
entries.summary: Produces a timed output pulse that can be extended by a qualifying retrigger condition.

entries.name: Binary decoder / demultiplexer
entries.summary: Uses binary selection and enable conditions to activate the documented selected output.

entries.name: Priority encoder
entries.summary: Encodes the highest-priority qualifying input into the specified binary output word.

entries.name: Digital multiplexer
entries.summary: Selects one of several digital inputs for the documented output according to its selection controls.

entries.name: Digital magnitude comparator
entries.summary: Compares two digital words to provide the specified equality and magnitude indications.

entries.name: Binary full adder
entries.summary: Adds binary input words with the documented carry-in and produces sum and carry outputs.

entries.name: Logic bus transceiver
entries.summary: Drives data between two digital buses according to the selected direction and enable conditions.

entries.name: Logic voltage-level translator
entries.summary: Transfers digital information between the documented logic-voltage domains.

entries.name: Open-collector buffer
entries.summary: Provides a logic output through a transistor pull-down stage requiring the documented external load or pull-up.

entries.name: Parity generator / checker
entries.summary: Computes a parity indication from the defined digital input word.

entries.name: Phase-locked loop
entries.summary: Controls an oscillator through a phase-comparison feedback arrangement to follow the documented reference.

entries.name: Voltage-controlled oscillator
entries.summary: Generates an oscillating output whose frequency responds to the documented control voltage.

entries.name: Clock generator
entries.summary: Provides the documented clock signal or signals used by digital circuitry.

entries.name: Watchdog timer
entries.summary: Supervises a qualifying activity signal and operates its output when the documented watchdog timing condition is violated.

entries.name: Operational amplifier
entries.summary: An analogue amplifier represented by inverting and non-inverting inputs, an output and its supply connections.

entries.name: Voltage comparator
entries.summary: Compares two analogue input voltages and produces the documented output-state indication.

entries.name: Instrumentation amplifier
entries.summary: Amplifies a differential input signal using an instrumentation-amplifier input and gain arrangement.

entries.name: Difference amplifier
entries.summary: Produces an analogue output related to the difference between two input signals with the documented gain/reference arrangement.

entries.name: Fully differential amplifier
entries.summary: Processes an analogue input to provide two complementary output signals around a defined common-mode level.

entries.name: Current-sense amplifier
entries.summary: Amplifies a voltage associated with a current-sensing shunt using the selected measurement-input arrangement.

entries.name: Isolation amplifier
entries.summary: Transfers an analogue measurement across the documented electrical isolation boundary.

entries.name: Operational transconductance amplifier
entries.summary: Produces an output current controlled by its differential input voltage and documented bias arrangement.

entries.name: Analogue multiplier
entries.summary: Produces an analogue output related to the product of two input quantities and the selected scaling/summing arrangement.

entries.name: Analogue bilateral switch
entries.summary: Connects or disconnects an analogue signal path under its documented digital control.

entries.name: Analogue multiplexer
entries.summary: Selects a continuous-signal channel through the documented controlled switching arrangement.

entries.name: Sample-and-hold amplifier
entries.summary: Acquires an analogue signal during the documented sampling interval and retains a representation during hold.

entries.name: Analogue-to-digital converter
entries.summary: Converts a sampled analogue quantity into the selected digital representation.

entries.name: Digital-to-analogue converter
entries.summary: Converts a digital code into the documented analogue output quantity.

entries.name: Series voltage reference
entries.summary: Provides a reference voltage through a series-connected supply and output arrangement.

entries.name: Shunt voltage reference
entries.summary: Establishes a reference voltage using a shunt-current path and the documented bias or feedback circuit.

entries.name: Precision rectifier
entries.summary: Uses an active amplifier/diode arrangement to rectify a signal according to the documented circuit.

entries.name: RMS-to-DC converter
entries.summary: Produces a DC output related to the RMS value of its input signal under the selected implementation.

entries.name: Voltage / frequency converter
entries.summary: Converts between an analogue voltage and a pulse-frequency representation in the documented selected configuration.

entries.name: Inverting amplifier circuit
entries.summary: Uses an amplifier feedback connection that produces the documented inverted signal relationship.

entries.name: Non-inverting amplifier circuit
entries.summary: Uses an amplifier feedback arrangement to amplify a signal without the intended polarity inversion.

entries.name: Op-amp integrator
entries.summary: Uses a documented amplifier/capacitor feedback arrangement to obtain an integrating signal response.

entries.name: Op-amp differentiator
entries.summary: Uses an amplifier input/feedback arrangement to obtain a differentiating response over its intended operating band.

entries.name: Active low-pass filter
entries.summary: Passes the intended lower-frequency signal content while attenuating higher-frequency content through an active filter circuit.

entries.name: Active high-pass filter
entries.summary: Attenuates lower-frequency content while passing the intended higher-frequency signal band.

entries.name: Active band-pass filter
entries.summary: Passes an intended frequency band while attenuating content below and above that band.

entries.name: Active notch filter
entries.summary: Attenuates a defined frequency region while retaining the intended content outside it.

entries.name: Transimpedance amplifier
entries.summary: Converts an input current into an output voltage through the documented feedback arrangement.

entries.name: Buck converter topology
entries.summary: A switching converter arrangement used to produce a lower DC output from its input under the documented operating conditions.

entries.name: Boost converter topology
entries.summary: A switching converter arrangement used to obtain a higher DC output from its documented input range.

entries.name: Inverting buck-boost topology
entries.summary: A buck-boost arrangement whose output polarity is opposite to its defined input reference.

entries.name: Four-switch buck-boost topology
entries.summary: A non-inverting conversion arrangement with switching legs that support documented buck and boost operation.

entries.name: SEPIC converter topology
entries.summary: A non-inverting conversion topology using its documented inductive and series-capacitor energy-transfer arrangement.

entries.name: Cuk converter topology
entries.summary: An inverting conversion topology using a capacitor as part of the energy-transfer path between inductive stages.

entries.name: Zeta converter topology
entries.summary: A non-inverting converter arrangement using its documented inductive and capacitive transfer circuit.

entries.name: Flyback converter topology
entries.summary: A conversion arrangement that uses coupled magnetic energy storage and transfers energy through the documented switching sequence.

entries.name: Forward converter topology
entries.summary: A conversion topology transferring power through coupled windings during the documented primary conduction interval.

entries.name: Active-clamp forward topology
entries.summary: A forward converter arrangement with an actively controlled clamp/reset circuit.

entries.name: Push-pull converter topology
entries.summary: A converter arrangement driving two primary paths alternately through the documented coupled winding.

entries.name: Half-bridge DC converter topology
entries.summary: A DC conversion stage using one switching leg and the documented magnetic/secondary circuit.

entries.name: Full-bridge DC converter topology
entries.summary: A DC conversion stage using two switching legs to apply the documented waveform to a magnetic primary.

entries.name: Phase-shifted full-bridge topology
entries.summary: A full-bridge conversion arrangement controlled through the documented relative switching-leg phase shift.

entries.name: LLC resonant converter topology
entries.summary: A converter arrangement using the documented resonant inductive/capacitive network and magnetic transfer path.

entries.name: Dual-active-bridge topology
entries.summary: A conversion stage with controlled bridges on both sides of a coupled magnetic link.

entries.name: Single-phase voltage-source inverter
entries.summary: A switching bridge that forms a documented single-phase AC output from a DC-link source.

entries.name: Three-phase voltage-source inverter
entries.summary: A three-leg bridge producing the documented three-phase output from a DC-link source.

entries.name: Neutral-point-clamped inverter
entries.summary: A multilevel switching arrangement using the documented split DC link and neutral-point clamping paths.

entries.name: Active front-end rectifier
entries.summary: An actively switched AC/DC stage using a documented current-control and DC-link regulation arrangement.

entries.name: Battery fuel gauge
entries.summary: A battery fuel gauge estimates how much usable charge remains in a battery.

entries.name: Battery charger controller
entries.summary: A battery charger controller manages the charging process for the selected battery system.

entries.name: Battery protection controller
entries.summary: A battery protection controller monitors selected limits and requests protective action when its conditions are reached.

entries.name: Battery cell voltage monitor

entries.summary: A cell voltage monitor measures individual cells within a series-connected battery.

entries.name: Passive battery cell balancer
aliases: Passive battery cell balancer functional block
Passive battery cell balancer schematic reference
entries.summary: A passive balancer removes some energy from selected cells through a dissipative path.

entries.name: Active battery cell balancer
aliases: Active battery cell balancer functional block
Active battery cell balancer schematic reference
entries.summary: An active balancer transfers energy between selected parts of a battery system.

entries.name: Battery cell temperature monitor
aliases: Battery cell temperature monitor functional block
Battery cell temperature monitor schematic reference
entries.summary: A cell temperature monitor reads sensors located at specified points in a battery assembly.

entries.name: Battery pack monitor
entries.summary: A pack monitor measures quantities associated with the complete battery pack.

entries.name: Battery precharge circuit
entries.summary: A precharge circuit limits the initial current used to charge downstream capacitance before a main connection closes.

entries.name: Battery insulation monitoring function
aliases: Battery insulation monitoring function functional block
Battery insulation monitoring function schematic reference
entries.summary: An insulation monitoring function assesses the electrical insulation between the monitored circuit and its reference structure.

entries.name: Battery pack current measurement
aliases: Battery pack current measurement functional block
Battery pack current measurement schematic reference
entries.summary: Pack-current measurement reports current entering or leaving the battery.

entries.name: AC electric vehicle charge point
aliases: AC electric vehicle charge point functional block
AC electric vehicle charge point schematic reference
entries.summary: An AC charge point controls the AC supply and charging interface presented to a vehicle.

entries.name: EV control pilot interface
aliases: EV control pilot interface functional block
EV control pilot interface schematic reference
entries.summary: The control pilot is part of the signalling interface between charging equipment and a vehicle.

entries.name: EV charging residual-current detection
aliases: EV charging residual-current detection functional block
EV charging residual-current detection schematic reference
entries.summary: Residual-current detection checks for specified unintended current paths in a charging system.

entries.name: EV charging contactor control
aliases: EV charging contactor control functional block
EV charging contactor control schematic reference
entries.summary: A charging contactor control function commands the switching device in the charging power path.

entries.name: DC electric vehicle charging station
aliases: DC electric vehicle charging station functional block
DC electric vehicle charging station schematic reference
entries.summary: A DC charging station performs offboard power conversion and supplies controlled DC to the vehicle interface.

entries.name: Bidirectional EV charging interface
aliases: Bidirectional EV charging interface functional block
Bidirectional EV charging interface schematic reference
entries.summary: A bidirectional charging interface supports controlled energy transfer in both permitted directions.

entries.name: EV charger power module
aliases: EV charger power module functional block
EV charger power module schematic reference
entries.summary: A charger power module is one conversion building block within a charging system.

entries.name: EV charging energy measurement
aliases: EV charging energy measurement functional block
EV charging energy measurement schematic reference
entries.summary: Charging energy measurement records the electrical energy passing through the defined measuring point.

entries.name: Photovoltaic module
entries.summary: A photovoltaic module converts light into DC electrical power.

entries.name: Photovoltaic string
entries.summary: A photovoltaic string is a defined series-connected group of modules.

entries.name: Photovoltaic string combiner
entries.summary: A string combiner brings identified solar DC circuits together at a defined connection arrangement.

entries.name: MPPT solar charge controller
aliases: MPPT solar charge controller functional block
MPPT solar charge controller schematic reference
entries.summary: An MPPT charge controller adjusts a solar operating point while controlling its charging output.

entries.name: Photovoltaic power optimiser
entries.summary: A solar power optimiser uses conversion and control at a selected module or input level.

entries.name: Photovoltaic rapid shutdown function
aliases: Photovoltaic rapid shutdown function functional block
Photovoltaic rapid shutdown function schematic reference
entries.summary: Rapid shutdown is a defined solar-system function that changes specified circuit conditions following a shutdown command.

entries.name: Photovoltaic arc-fault detection
entries.summary: Solar arc-fault detection analyses monitored circuit behaviour for signs of specified electrical arcing.

entries.name: CAN bus transceiver
entries.summary: CAN (Controller Area Network) lets electronic devices exchange messages. A transceiver is the part that sends and receives the network's electrical signals.

entries.name: CAN FD transceiver
entries.summary: CAN FD means CAN with Flexible Data Rate. Its transceiver sends and receives the electrical signals used by that compatible network.

entries.name: LIN bus transceiver
entries.summary: LIN means Local Interconnect Network, a communication system for connected electronic devices. Its transceiver handles the network's electrical signals.

entries.name: RS-485 transceiver
entries.summary: An RS-485 transceiver sends and receives differential serial signals on its specified bus arrangement.

entries.name: RS-422 interface
entries.summary: An RS-422 interface uses differential signalling for its selected serial connection.

entries.name: RS-232 transceiver
entries.summary: An RS-232 transceiver converts between logic-level serial signals and the selected RS-232 electrical interface.

entries.name: Ethernet physical-layer transceiver
entries.summary: An Ethernet PHY handles the electrical signalling of the selected Ethernet physical link.

entries.name: Single-pair Ethernet interface
entries.summary: A single-pair Ethernet interface uses its specified physical-layer arrangement over one conductor pair.

entries.name: PoE powered-device interface
entries.summary: A PoE powered-device interface manages the receiving end of power delivered over a compatible Ethernet link.

entries.name: PoE power-sourcing interface
entries.summary: A PoE power-sourcing interface manages the supply end of a compatible powered Ethernet connection.

entries.name: I2C bus buffer
entries.summary: An I2C bus buffer separates or supports selected parts of an I2C connection.

entries.name: I2C voltage-level translator
entries.summary: An I2C level translator adapts the specified logic-voltage levels between compatible bus sections.

entries.name: SPI interface buffer
entries.summary: An SPI buffer supports the selected digital signal paths between an SPI controller and its peripheral interface.

entries.name: LVDS line driver
entries.summary: An LVDS driver converts a logic signal into the selected low-voltage differential output.

entries.name: LVDS line receiver
entries.summary: An LVDS receiver converts a compatible differential input into its specified logic output.

entries.name: Magnetic digital isolator
entries.summary: A magnetic digital isolator transfers digital information across its isolation barrier using magnetic coupling.

entries.name: Isolated comparator
entries.summary: An isolated comparator evaluates an input condition and transfers its comparison result across an isolation barrier.

entries.name: Isolated CAN transceiver
entries.summary: An isolated CAN interface combines a CAN signal path with its specified electrical isolation barrier.

entries.name: Isolated RS-485 transceiver
entries.summary: An isolated RS-485 interface transfers compatible serial communication across a specified isolation barrier.

entries.name: Isolated I2C interface
entries.summary: An isolated I2C interface transfers the required bus behaviour across an electrical isolation barrier.

entries.name: Isolated analogue-to-digital converter
entries.summary: An isolated ADC converts an analogue measurement into digital information across its specified isolation arrangement.

entries.name: Power-source multiplexer
entries.summary: A power multiplexer selects between defined supply paths feeding an output.

entries.name: Reverse-polarity protection controller
entries.summary: A reverse-polarity protection controller manages a power path against a specified reversed connection condition.

entries.name: Integrated load switch
entries.summary: An integrated load switch connects or disconnects a supply path under an enable or control signal.

entries.name: Smart high-side switch
entries.summary: A high-side switch controls the connection between a supply and the high side of a load.

entries.name: Low-side power switch
entries.summary: A low-side switch controls the return-side connection of a load in its specified circuit.

entries.name: Linear voltage regulator
entries.summary: A linear regulator controls its pass element to maintain a specified output voltage from a suitable input.

entries.name: Low-dropout voltage regulator
entries.summary: An LDO is a linear voltage regulator designed to operate with its specified small input-to-output voltage headroom.

entries.name: Supply voltage supervisor
entries.summary: A voltage supervisor checks a supply against specified conditions and produces a status or reset signal.

entries.name: Power-good indication
entries.summary: A power-good signal reports whether the source's specified acceptable-supply conditions are satisfied.

entries.name: Window voltage supervisor
entries.summary: A window supervisor checks whether a monitored voltage stays between its specified lower and upper limits.

entries.name: Power-rail sequencer
entries.summary: A power sequencer controls the order in which selected supply rails are enabled or disabled.

entries.name: Power-rail enable interface
entries.summary: An enable interface requests a selected power supply or switched rail to operate.

entries.name: Hall-effect current sensor
entries.summary: A Hall-effect current sensor uses a magnetic-field response to measure current.

entries.name: Magnetic position sensor
entries.summary: A magnetic position sensor measures or detects position through the magnetic field associated with a target.

entries.name: Inductive position sensor
entries.summary: An inductive position sensor uses an electromagnetic interaction to infer a target's position.

entries.name: Ultrasonic distance sensor
entries.summary: An ultrasonic distance sensor uses sound beyond normal human hearing to obtain distance information.

entries.name: Radar level sensing function
aliases: Radar level sensing function functional block
Radar level sensing function schematic reference
entries.summary: A radar sensing function uses radio-frequency signals to obtain information about a target or surface.

entries.name: Pressure measurement interface
entries.summary: A pressure interface converts the selected pressure sensor's response into usable measurement information.

entries.name: Capacitive level sensor
entries.summary: A capacitive level sensor uses a change in capacitance associated with material near its sensing arrangement.

entries.name: Relative humidity sensor
entries.summary: A relative humidity sensor measures moisture in air relative to the saturation condition at the relevant temperature.

entries.name: Flexible conductor

entries.name: Screened conductor

entries.name: Conductor in conduit

entries.name: Underground cable

symbolVariant.reference: Independent IEC-context illustration; not certified IEC geometry.

entries.name: Underwater cable
entries.summary: A cable section marked as laid under water, such as a river crossing, offshore export cable or lake crossing.

symbolVariant.reference: Independent IEC-context illustration; not certified IEC geometry.

entries.name: Optical fibre cable
entries.summary: A cable line carrying light rather than current, used for protection signalling, SCADA links and substation process bus.

entries.name: Conductors within one cable

symbolVariant.reference: Independent IEC-context illustration; not certified IEC geometry.

entries.name: Conductor count by numeral
entries.summary: A single oblique stroke across a line with a number beside it, stating how many conductors the single line represents.

entries.summary: A mark on a single-line conductor group identifying which conductor is the neutral, often drawn as a small circle on a stroke.

symbolVariant.reference: Independent IEC-context illustration; not certified IEC geometry.

symbolVariant.reference: Independent IEC-context illustration; not certified IEC geometry.

entries.summary: Device that measures voltage and current phasors with precise time stamps so angles can be compared across a network.

entries.name: Active-power transducer
entries.summary: Measuring transducer that converts CT and VT inputs into a DC signal proportional to active power for SCADA or control.

entries.name: Voltage measuring transducer
entries.summary: Transducer that converts a VT secondary or direct voltage into an isolated analogue signal for remote measurement.

entries.name: Multi-core current transformer
entries.summary: CT with several independent magnetic cores on one primary, each with its own secondary for metering or protection.

entries.name: Summation current transformer
entries.summary: Auxiliary CT with several primary windings that adds the secondary currents of other CTs into one output.

entries.name: Interposing current transformer
entries.summary: Auxiliary CT inserted in a CT secondary circuit to correct ratio, phase shift or provide isolation for a relay.

entries.name: Rogowski coil current sensor
entries.summary: Air-cored coil around a conductor whose output voltage is proportional to the rate of change of current.

entries.name: Wound-primary current transformer
entries.summary: CT with a primary winding of several turns, used for low primary currents where a bar primary gives too little accuracy.

entries.name: Bushing current transformer
entries.summary: Toroidal CT mounted around a transformer or breaker bushing, often with a tapped multi-ratio secondary.

entries.name: Voltage transformer with two secondary windings
aliases: VT with metering and protection windings
entries.summary: VT with two separate secondary windings, typically one for metering and one for protection, each with its own fusing.

entries.name: Voltage transformer set with broken-delta residual winding
entries.summary: Three single-phase VTs whose residual windings are connected in broken delta to produce the zero-sequence voltage.

entries.name: Open-delta voltage transformer connection
entries.summary: Two phase-to-phase VTs connected in V to provide all three line voltages without a neutral reference.

entries.name: Combined instrument transformer
entries.summary: Single unit housing a current transformer and voltage transformer for each phase, typical of MV and HV metering points.

entries.name: Resistive voltage divider sensor
entries.summary: Low-power voltage sensor using a resistive divider to give a small voltage signal proportional to primary voltage.

entries.name: Low-power current transformer
entries.summary: Small iron-core CT with an integral shunt that delivers a low-level voltage signal instead of a standard secondary current.

entries.name: Optical current sensor
entries.summary: Current sensor using light in an optical fibre around the conductor, whose polarisation changes with the magnetic field.

entries.name: Numerical protection relay (IED)
entries.summary: Single relay block on an SLD that lists the protection functions it provides, with CT, VT and trip connections.

entries.name: Trip-circuit supervision relay
entries.summary: Relay that passes a small current through the trip circuit to check continuity and alarms if the circuit is broken.

entries.name: Buchholz relay
entries.summary: Gas-and-oil actuated relay in the pipe to the conservator, giving alarm on gas build-up and trip on oil surge.

entries.name: Winding temperature indicator
entries.summary: Transformer indicator that adds a CT-heated thermal image to top-oil temperature to estimate winding hot-spot temperature.

entries.name: Thermistor motor protection relay
entries.summary: Relay that monitors PTC thermistors embedded in motor windings and trips when their resistance rises at the rated temperature.

entries.name: Arc-flash point light sensor
entries.summary: Light sensor in a switchgear compartment that detects the flash of an internal arc and signals an arc-flash relay.

entries.name: Arc-flash fibre loop sensor
entries.summary: Bare optical fibre routed through switchgear that picks up arc light anywhere along its length.

entries.name: Residual current monitor
entries.summary: Device with a toroid that measures residual current and gives a warning or signal without interrupting the circuit itself.

entries.name: Definite-time delay qualifier for measuring relays
entries.summary: Qualifier added to a measuring relay symbol to show that operation follows a fixed time delay after pick-up.

entries.name: Inverse-time characteristic qualifier
entries.summary: Qualifier showing that a measuring relay's operating time falls as the measured quantity rises above its setting.

entries.name: Directional measuring element qualifier
entries.summary: Arrow qualifier on a measuring relay showing that it operates only for power or current in the marked direction.

entries.name: Relay test block
entries.summary: Multi-pole test facility between CT, VT and trip wiring and a relay, allowing safe isolation and test injection.

entries.name: Test plug
entries.summary: Plug inserted into a test block or switch to connect test equipment to the relay side while isolating the plant side.

entries.name: Current test switch with shorting contact
entries.summary: Panel test switch for CT circuits that shorts the CT side before opening the relay side, with a test jack between.

entries.name: Potential test switch
entries.summary: Panel test switch that opens a VT secondary circuit to a relay or meter so test voltages can be applied safely.

entries.name: Synchronising lamps
entries.summary: Set of lamps connected between incoming and running phases that brighten and dim with the phase difference during synchronising.

entries.name: Fault passage indicator
entries.summary: Device on an MV cable or overhead feeder that shows whether fault current has passed its location, to speed fault finding.

entries.name: Surge arrester counter
entries.summary: Counter in a surge arrester's earth lead that registers discharges and often shows leakage current.

entries.name: Vibration sensor
entries.summary: Sensor on a machine bearing that measures vibration and feeds a monitor or relay for alarm and trip.

entries.name: Partial discharge sensor
entries.summary: Sensor on switchgear, cables or transformers that picks up signals from partial discharge for insulation condition monitoring.

entries.name: Fixed-speed wind turbine generator (Type 1)
entries.summary: A wind turbine whose squirrel-cage induction generator connects to the network directly, running at nearly constant speed.

entries.name: Variable-slip wind turbine generator (Type 2)
entries.summary: A wind turbine using a wound-rotor induction generator with controlled external rotor resistance to widen the slip range.

entries.name: Doubly-fed induction generator
entries.summary: A wound-rotor induction generator with the stator on the network and the rotor fed through a back-to-back converter sized for slip power.

entries.name: Full-converter wind turbine generator (Type 4)
entries.summary: A wind turbine whose entire generator output passes through a full-rated back-to-back converter before reaching the network.

entries.name: Three-phase induction generator
entries.summary: A squirrel-cage asynchronous machine driven above synchronous speed so that it delivers power into a three-phase network.

entries.name: Single-phase synchronous generator
entries.summary: A synchronous alternator delivering a single-phase output, common on small portable and standby generating sets.

entries.name: Synchronous generator with brushless exciter
entries.summary: A synchronous alternator shown with its exciter machine and rotating rectifier, as used on most generating sets.

entries.name: ANSI/IEEE permanent-magnet synchronous generator symbol
entries.summary: IEEE-oriented library form of a three-phase synchronous generator with permanent-magnet excitation, with reading notes.

symbolVariant.form: Autodesk IEEE-oriented 3 Phase Synchro Generator with Permanent Magnets functional form
symbolVariant.reference: Autodesk publishes this block under its IEEE Symbol Preview for generators. The counterpart is the matching functional concept; no equivalence of every detailed standard graphic is asserted.

entries.name: ANSI/IEEE compound-excited DC generator symbol
entries.summary: IEEE-oriented library form of a DC generator with both series and shunt field windings, for drawing lookup.

symbolVariant.form: Autodesk IEEE-oriented DC Generator with Compound Excitation functional form
symbolVariant.reference: Autodesk publishes this block under its IEEE Symbol Preview for generators. The counterpart is the matching functional concept; no equivalence of every detailed standard graphic is asserted.

entries.name: Diesel generator set
entries.summary: A compression-ignition engine coupled to an alternator, shown as a source on microgrid and standby power single-line diagrams.

entries.name: Gas engine generator set
entries.summary: A spark-ignited reciprocating engine on natural gas, biogas or LPG driving an alternator, shown as a generating source.

entries.name: Gas turbine generator
entries.summary: A combustion gas turbine coupled to a synchronous generator, often through a gearbox, shown as a generating unit.

entries.name: Hydro turbine generator
entries.summary: A water turbine driving a generator, used for mini and micro hydro sources within microgrids and remote supplies.

entries.name: Fuel cell
entries.summary: An electrochemical source that converts hydrogen or another fuel directly into DC electricity, usually followed by a converter.

entries.name: Hydrogen electrolyser
entries.summary: A DC load that splits water into hydrogen and oxygen, supplied through a rectifier as a controllable sink in a microgrid.

entries.name: Flywheel energy storage
entries.summary: A rotating mass coupled to a motor-generator and converter that stores energy kinetically for short, high-power bursts.

entries.name: Supercapacitor bank
entries.summary: A series-parallel array of double-layer capacitor cells storing energy for very fast, short-duration power delivery.

entries.name: Single battery cell
entries.summary: One electrochemical cell drawn as a single long plate and short plate pair, marking cell-level voltage and polarity.

entries.name: Battery string
entries.summary: A series connection of cells or modules reaching the system DC voltage, often with its own fuse or breaker and monitoring.

entries.name: Battery rack
entries.summary: A rack of series-connected battery modules with its own switchgear and battery management unit, forming one DC source.

entries.name: Battery energy storage system
entries.summary: A complete battery plant block combining batteries, power conversion and controls, shown as one source or sink on an SLD.

entries.name: Centre-tapped battery bank
entries.summary: A battery bank with a mid-point connection that provides positive and negative rails about a common centre point.

entries.name: ANSI/IEEE battery symbol
entries.summary: IEEE-style multi-cell battery drawn as alternating long and short plates, with polarity marked, for American drawing sets.

symbolVariant.form: IEEE-style multi-cell battery with omitted-cell gap
symbolVariant.reference: Form described from IEEE/ANSI 315 drawing practice as publicly summarised; no certified reproduction of the standard graphic is asserted.

entries.name: Battery power conversion system
entries.summary: The bidirectional inverter stage of a battery plant that charges and discharges the DC battery from the AC network.

entries.name: Float and boost battery charger
entries.summary: A rectifier charger that holds a stationary battery at float voltage and can apply a higher boost or equalise voltage.

entries.name: Thyristor phase-controlled rectifier
entries.summary: An AC-to-DC converter using thyristors fired at a controlled angle to set its DC output voltage.

entries.name: Twelve-pulse rectifier
entries.summary: Two six-pulse bridges fed from star and delta transformer windings 30 degrees apart, cancelling the lowest harmonics.

entries.name: Grid-forming inverter
entries.summary: An inverter controlled as a voltage source that sets its own voltage and frequency, able to energise and hold up an island.

entries.name: Grid-following inverter
entries.summary: An inverter that tracks an existing network voltage with a phase-locked loop and injects controlled current into it.

entries.name: Hybrid inverter
entries.summary: A single inverter with PV, battery and AC ports, combining MPPT charging, battery inversion and backup output.

entries.name: Bidirectional inverter-charger
entries.summary: A battery converter that charges from an AC source and inverts back to AC, with an internal transfer relay for the load.

entries.name: PV string inverter
entries.summary: A solar inverter connecting a small number of PV strings directly, each group tracked by its own MPPT input.

entries.name: PV central inverter
entries.summary: A large solar inverter fed from DC combiner boxes, usually paired with its own medium-voltage transformer.

entries.name: PV microinverter
entries.summary: A small inverter attached to one or two PV modules, converting to AC at the module and paralleling on an AC trunk cable.

entries.name: Bidirectional DC-to-DC converter
entries.summary: A DC/DC stage that can pass power in either direction, linking a battery or supercapacitor to a DC bus.

entries.name: Isolated DC-to-DC converter
entries.summary: A DC/DC converter with an internal high-frequency transformer that separates input and output galvanically.

entries.name: Static frequency converter
entries.summary: A rectifier and inverter in one unit that converts AC at one frequency to AC at another, such as 50 Hz to 60 Hz.

entries.name: Motor-generator set
entries.summary: A motor mechanically coupled to a generator, used to isolate, change frequency or convert between AC and DC.

entries.name: Static transfer switch
entries.summary: A thyristor-based switch that transfers a load between two synchronised sources within a quarter cycle.

entries.name: Automatic transfer switch
entries.summary: A mechanically switched changeover device that automatically moves a load from a failed normal source to an alternate source.

entries.name: Manual transfer switch
entries.summary: An operator-moved changeover switch that selects which of two sources supplies a load, with an off position between them.

entries.name: Closed-transition transfer switch
entries.summary: A transfer switch that briefly parallels two synchronised sources so the load moves without interruption.

entries.name: Bypass-isolation transfer switch
entries.summary: An automatic transfer switch paired with a manual bypass switch so the ATS can be isolated for maintenance without losing the load.

entries.name: Online double-conversion UPS
entries.summary: A UPS whose rectifier and inverter carry the load continuously, with the battery on the DC link and a static bypass.

entries.name: Line-interactive UPS
entries.summary: A UPS that passes mains to the load through a voltage-correcting stage and switches to its bidirectional inverter on failure.

entries.name: Offline standby UPS
entries.summary: A UPS that passes raw mains straight to the load and starts its inverter only when mains is lost.

entries.name: Rotary UPS
entries.summary: A UPS built around a rotating synchronous machine with kinetic storage, often coupled to a diesel engine for long backup.

entries.name: UPS maintenance bypass
entries.summary: An arrangement of interlocked switches that routes the load around a UPS so the UPS can be isolated for work.

entries.name: Static var compensator
entries.summary: A shunt reactive power compensator built from thyristor-controlled reactors, thyristor-switched capacitors and filters.

entries.name: Thyristor-controlled reactor
entries.summary: A shunt reactor in series with anti-parallel thyristors whose firing angle sets the reactive power absorbed.

entries.name: Thyristor-switched capacitor
entries.summary: A capacitor bank switched in or out at current zero by anti-parallel thyristors, giving fast stepwise reactive support.

entries.name: Static synchronous compensator
entries.summary: A voltage-source converter in shunt that injects or absorbs reactive current to support voltage, independent of system voltage.

entries.name: Synchronous condenser
entries.summary: An unloaded synchronous machine on the network that supplies reactive power, inertia and short-circuit strength.

entries.name: Single-tuned harmonic filter
entries.summary: A shunt series-LC branch tuned near one harmonic order to sink that harmonic current from the network.

entries.name: Damped high-pass harmonic filter
entries.summary: A shunt filter with a resistor across its reactor, giving low impedance over a broad band of higher harmonics.

entries.name: Active harmonic filter
entries.summary: A shunt converter that measures load harmonics and injects opposing currents to cancel them at the connection point.

entries.name: Detuned capacitor bank
entries.summary: Power factor correction capacitors with series reactors that tune each step below the lowest significant harmonic.

entries.name: Dynamic voltage restorer
entries.summary: A series converter that injects a corrective voltage through a transformer to ride a sensitive load through voltage sags.

entries.name: Point of common coupling
entries.summary: A marker on a single-line diagram identifying where a customer installation or microgrid meets the public network.

entries.name: Utility grid connection
entries.summary: The symbol for the external utility network as a supply source at the top of a single-line diagram.

entries.name: Grid equivalent source
entries.summary: A voltage source behind an impedance used in study diagrams to represent the external network at a defined fault level.

entries.name: Microgrid interconnection switch
entries.summary: The switching device that separates a microgrid from the utility for islanding and reconnects it after synchronising.

entries.name: Resistive load bank
entries.summary: A bank of switched resistive elements used to apply a controllable test load to generators, UPS or battery systems.

entries.name: Resistive-reactive load bank
entries.summary: A test load bank combining resistive and inductive steps to load a generator at its rated power factor.

entries.name: Neutral earthing resistor
entries.summary: A resistor between a transformer or generator neutral and earth that limits earth-fault current to a set value.

entries.name: Arc suppression coil
entries.summary: An adjustable reactor between neutral and earth tuned to cancel the network capacitive earth-fault current.

entries.name: Microgrid controller
entries.summary: The supervisory controller that dispatches sources, storage and loads and manages islanding and reconnection of a microgrid.

entries.name: Genset controller
entries.summary: The device controller that starts, protects and synchronises a generating set and controls its breaker.

entries.name: Power plant controller
entries.summary: The plant-level controller that measures at the connection point and sets inverter or turbine outputs to meet grid requirements.

entries.name: Dump load controller
entries.summary: A controller that diverts surplus generation into a resistive dump load to hold frequency or voltage in a small isolated system.

entries.name: Split-phase inverter
entries.summary: An inverter with two 180-degree displaced outputs and a neutral, supplying 120/240 V split-phase installations.
