entries.name: Breaker shunt-trip coil
entries.summary: Uses an externally supplied electrical pulse to release the breaker opening mechanism.

entries.name: Breaker trip coil one interface
entries.summary: Identifies the first opening coil in a breaker with separately wired trip paths.

entries.name: Breaker trip coil two interface
entries.summary: Identifies the second opening coil and its separately documented protection channel.

entries.name: Independent trip-supply changeover
entries.summary: Selects an available supply for a documented trip circuit without merging the two source circuits.

entries.name: Trip-coil pulse extension
entries.summary: Maintains an opening command for the duration required by the selected operating mechanism.

entries.name: Trip-output interposing relay
entries.summary: Transfers a protective-relay output to an opening circuit with a different electrical duty.

entries.name: Trip-coil isolation test link
entries.summary: Provides a documented disconnect point between a trip output and its operating coil.

entries.name: Protection trip distribution matrix
entries.summary: Routes each protection initiation to the breakers assigned to the affected protection zone.

entries.name: Manual emergency-trip path
entries.summary: Shows the hardwired opening request issued by the designated emergency control station.

entries.name: Lockout-mediated breaker trip
entries.summary: Passes a protection initiation through a latched lockout function before the assigned breaker trips.

entries.name: Direct protection-to-coil trip
entries.summary: Shows an opening output connected to the breaker trip circuit without an intervening lockout function.

entries.name: Dual-channel trip segregation
entries.summary: Keeps the two documented opening-command channels electrically identifiable through the terminal strip.

entries.name: Trip positive-conductor supervision
entries.summary: Monitors continuity on the positive side of a documented breaker opening circuit.

entries.name: Trip return-conductor supervision
entries.summary: Monitors the documented return side rather than assuming a healthy positive feed proves continuity.

entries.name: Breaker open-trip seal-in contact
entries.summary: Sustains a trip request through its designed seal-in path until the specified feedback terminates it.

entries.name: Breaker trip-counter pulse
entries.summary: Produces a counting event when the defined trip operation is detected.

entries.name: Breaker closing-coil interface
entries.summary: Connects the final permitted close command to the breaker closing release.

entries.name: Breaker anti-pumping control
entries.summary: Prevents repeated closing attempts while a close request remains continuously applied.

entries.name: Breaker close-pulse shaping
entries.summary: Converts a maintained supervisory request into the documented finite closing pulse.

entries.name: Spring-charged closing permissive
entries.summary: Allows the closing path only when the stored-energy mechanism reports ready.

entries.name: Breaker open-position closing permissive
entries.summary: Uses the documented open-position feedback before issuing another close command.

entries.name: Lockout-reset closing permissive
entries.summary: Blocks the closing path while the assigned protection lockout remains active.

entries.name: Breaker ready-to-close aggregation
entries.summary: Combines the separately documented mechanism and protection conditions into one readiness indication.

entries.name: Local closing-command channel
entries.summary: Identifies closing requests originating at the switchgear's local operating station.

entries.name: Remote closing-command channel
entries.summary: Identifies a supervisory closing request received from the control system.

entries.name: Closing-command priority selection
entries.summary: Resolves simultaneous local and remote closing requests using the defined control authority.

entries.name: Dead-bus close permission
entries.summary: Allows the documented source to energize a bus established as dead by its voltage checks.

entries.name: Live-bus synchronised closing gate
entries.summary: Requires the defined synchronising conditions before connecting two live AC systems.

entries.name: Closing-circuit fuse-failure alarm
entries.summary: Reports loss of the supply or fuse continuity serving the closing release.

entries.name: Closing-coil isolation test link
entries.summary: Marks the removable connection used to separate closing control from the breaker coil.

entries.name: Breaker close-failure timer
entries.summary: Detects that the requested close was not confirmed within the configured supervision interval.

entries.name: Close-command cancellation input
entries.summary: Withdraws an unexecuted closing request when its defined cancellation condition occurs.

entries.name: Breaker 52a auxiliary-contact interface
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Uses the breaker auxiliary contact that follows the documented closed main-contact condition.

entries.name: Breaker 52b auxiliary-contact interface
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Uses the complementary breaker auxiliary contact associated with the documented open condition.

entries.name: Breaker double-point status decoding
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Interprets the two independent auxiliary indications as open, closed or an invalid combination.

entries.name: Breaker position-discrepancy alarm
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Reports an auxiliary-contact combination that persists beyond the allowed transition interval.

entries.name: Breaker intermediate-position indication
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Identifies the temporary or unresolved state between the defined open and closed indications.

entries.name: Breaker mechanism-operated contact interface
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Reports the breaker mechanism position through a compartment-mounted mechanism-operated contact assembly.

entries.name: Breaker truck-operated contact interface
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Reports the removable truck's connection state through its truck-operated contact assembly.

entries.name: Breaker service-position proof
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Confirms that the drawout element has reached its defined service connection position.

entries.name: Breaker test-position proof
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Confirms the defined test position where the documented secondary-control connection can remain available.

entries.name: Breaker disconnected-position proof
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Identifies the documented disconnected truck position independently of an open main contact.

entries.name: Breaker withdrawn-position indication
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Reports that the removable breaker is outside its normal connected operating position.

entries.name: Breaker control-plug engaged indication
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Reports the documented connection of the secondary control plug.

entries.name: Breaker spring-charge status interface
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Carries the mechanism's stored-energy status into the control and indication system.

entries.name: Breaker operation-count feedback
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Identifies a feedback event representing a completed defined mechanical operation.

entries.name: Breaker trip-cause indication
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Retains the originating protection or control cause associated with the recorded opening event.

entries.name: Breaker local-remote authority indication
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
entries.summary: Reports which operating location currently has command authority over the breaker.

entries.name: Breaker-open disconnector interlock
entries.summary: Blocks disconnector movement until the specified breaker-open condition has been established.

entries.name: Disconnector-closed breaker interlock
entries.summary: Requires the selected disconnector to occupy its defined closed position before breaker closing.

entries.name: Earthing-switch-open breaker interlock
entries.summary: Blocks closing toward a circuit when the associated earthing switch is not proved open.

entries.name: Breaker-open earthing interlock
entries.summary: Uses the assigned breaker state as one condition of earthing-switch operation.

entries.name: Truck-position racking interlock
entries.summary: Restricts breaker racking according to its documented operating and truck-position conditions.

entries.name: Shutter-access interlock interface
entries.summary: Relates primary-contact shutter position to the documented access restrictions.

entries.name: Cable-compartment door interlock
entries.summary: Relates access to the cable compartment to the equipment states defined by its interlocking scheme.

entries.name: Trapped-key transfer permissive
entries.summary: Represents the required transfer of a key between equipment to enforce an operating dependency.

entries.name: Dual-incomer parallel-closing interlock
entries.summary: Restricts simultaneous incomer connection when the installation is not designed for source paralleling.

entries.name: Incomer-bus-tie interlock matrix
entries.summary: Checks the assigned incomer and tie combinations against the permitted switchboard configurations.

entries.name: Local-remote command interlock
entries.summary: Accepts commands only from the location selected by the documented authority mechanism.

entries.name: Maintenance-mode closing inhibit
entries.summary: Suppresses the defined automatic closing paths while the assigned maintenance mode is selected.

entries.name: Test-mode output blocking
entries.summary: Separates a test initiation from the normal operating output under the documented test configuration.

entries.name: Invalid-position fail-block gate
entries.summary: Blocks the assigned operation when its required position inputs form an invalid combination.

entries.name: Interlock-bypass supervision
entries.summary: Indicates that a separately controlled interlock bypass is active in the monitored scheme.

entries.name: Interlock-permissive discrepancy alarm
entries.summary: Detects disagreement between the commanded permission and the expected interlock feedback.

entries.name: Breaker spring-charging motor circuit
entries.summary: Supplies the motor that restores the documented stored-energy closing mechanism.

entries.name: Spring-charging motor stop contact
entries.summary: Stops charging when the mechanism reaches the specified charged condition.

entries.name: Spring-charging motor run contact
entries.summary: Reports that the charging motor is operating rather than merely commanded.

entries.name: Spring-charge timeout alarm
entries.summary: Detects failure to obtain the charged indication within the defined supervision interval.

entries.name: Repeated spring-charging alarm
entries.summary: Flags an abnormal sequence of repeated charging operations under the specified monitoring rule.

entries.name: Charging-motor supply-loss alarm
entries.summary: Reports loss of the electrical supply serving the charging motor.

entries.name: Charging-motor overload indication
entries.summary: Carries the documented motor protective-device operation into the breaker alarm system.

entries.name: Stored-energy discharged indication
entries.summary: Reports the mechanism's documented discharged condition for control or maintenance indication.

entries.name: Manual spring-charging indication
entries.summary: Identifies the mechanically initiated charging state where the selected mechanism provides feedback.

entries.name: Hydraulic operating-pressure supervision
entries.summary: Uses the selected hydraulic mechanism's pressure switch or sensor as a readiness input.

entries.name: Pneumatic operating-pressure supervision
entries.summary: Reports whether the pneumatic mechanism has its specified operating-pressure condition.

entries.name: Mechanism pump-start control
entries.summary: Requests operation of the mechanism's pressure-maintaining pump according to its defined demand contact.

entries.name: Mechanism pump-run timeout
entries.summary: Detects an unusually sustained pressure-maintaining pump operation in the selected mechanism.

entries.name: Mechanism pressure-lockout interface
entries.summary: Carries the manufacturer's defined low-pressure blocking state to the command logic.

entries.name: Pole-operated mechanism discrepancy
entries.summary: Compares pole-operation feedback where the selected breaker has independently monitored poles.

entries.name: Mechanism maintenance-alarm interface
entries.summary: Brings a documented mechanism maintenance indication into the station alarm system.

entries.name: Dual-incomer normally-open bus tie

entries.name: Dual-incomer normally-closed bus tie
aliases: switchgear Switchboard source and bus interfaces
entries.summary: Shows the documented arrangement with the tie normally connected between the two sections.

entries.name: Three-breaker two-source transfer interface

entries.name: Main-tie-main source selection

entries.name: Generator incomer connection interface

entries.name: Utility incomer connection interface

entries.name: Bus-section protection-boundary interface

entries.name: Tie-breaker maintenance isolation interface

entries.name: Feeder backfeed monitoring interface

entries.name: Embedded-generation export interface

entries.name: Bus-section load-transfer request

entries.name: Incomer transfer-in-progress indication

entries.name: Source-transfer failure indication

entries.name: Reversing-starter electrical interlock
entries.summary: Blocks energization of opposite-direction contactors according to their documented feedback.

entries.name: Star-delta transition controller
entries.summary: Coordinates the documented change from starting winding connection to running connection.

entries.name: Soft-starter bypass command interface

entries.name: Variable-speed drive run-enable interface
entries.summary: Carries a permitted run command to the drive control interface.

entries.name: Motor restart-inhibit block

entries.name: Motor starts-per-hour restraint

entries.name: Motor underload process alarm

entries.name: Motor protection reset permissive

entries.name: Motor feeder available indication

entries.name: Remote-racking drive interface

entries.name: Disconnector motor operator interface

entries.name: Test-link normal-position supervision
